# Data Source: tfe_scim_group

(Only for Terraform Enterprise) Gets information on a SCIM group synchronized from an Identity Provider.

Requires admin token configurations. See example usage for incorporating an admin token into your provider config. Use `name` to look up a single group by its exact display name (case-insensitive). The data source filters out fuzzy substring matches returned by the API and keeps only exact matches.

## Example Usage

```java
import software.constructs.*;
import com.hashicorp.cdktf.*;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import gen.providers.tfe.provider.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.dataTfeScimGroup.*;
public class MyConvertedCode extends TerraformStack {
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, String name) {
        super(scope, name);
        /*Terraform Variables are not always the best fit for getting inputs in the context of Terraform CDK.
            You can read more about this at https://cdk.tf/variables*/
        TerraformVariable adminToken = TerraformVariable.Builder.create(this, "admin_token")
                .description("An admin access token")
                .build();
        TerraformVariable hostname = TerraformVariable.Builder.create(this, "hostname")
                .default("app.terraform.io")
                .description("The HCP Terraform or Enterprise hostname.")
                .build();
        TerraformVariable token = TerraformVariable.Builder.create(this, "token")
                .description("An access token")
                .build();
        new TfeProvider(this, "tfe", new TfeProviderConfig()
                .hostname(hostname.getStringValue())
                .token(token.getStringValue())
                );
        TfeProvider tfeAdmin = new TfeProvider(this, "tfe_4", new TfeProviderConfig()
                .alias("admin")
                .hostname(hostname.getStringValue())
                .token(adminToken.getStringValue())
                );
        DataTfeScimGroup dataTfeScimGroupAdmins = new DataTfeScimGroup(this, "admins", new DataTfeScimGroupConfig()
                .name("platform-admins")
                .provider(tfeAdmin)
                );
        TerraformOutput.Builder.create(this, "admin_group_id")
                .value(dataTfeScimGroupAdmins.getId())
                .build();
    }
}
```

                .description("The HCP Terraform or Enterprise hostname.")
                .build();
        TerraformVariable token = TerraformVariable.Builder.create(this, "token")
                .description("An access token")
                .build();
        new TfeProvider(this, "tfe", new TfeProviderConfig()
                .hostname(hostname.getStringValue())
                .token(token.getStringValue())
                );
        TfeProvider tfeAdmin = new TfeProvider(this, "tfe_4", new TfeProviderConfig()
                .alias("admin")
                .hostname(hostname.getStringValue())
                .token(adminToken.getStringValue())
                );
        DataTfeScimGroup dataTfeScimGroupSiteAdmins =
        new DataTfeScimGroup(this, "site_admins", new DataTfeScimGroupConfig()
                .name("tfe-site-admins")
                .provider(tfeAdmin)
                );
        new ScimSettings(this, "this", new ScimSettingsConfig()
                .provider(tfeAdmin)
                .siteAdminGroupScimId(Token.asString(dataTfeScimGroupSiteAdmins.getId()))
                );

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The exact name of the SCIM group to retrieve (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the SCIM group.
